Local graph diagnostics do not establish Neo4j service latency or live end-to-end gains.

Unordered result comparison does not verify requested row ordering or answer prose.
Model generation can vary even at temperature zero; no causal claim from one run.

cases.question: Who is enrolled in a Bachelor degree program? List the first name, middle name, last name.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.first_name ,  T1.middle_name ,  T1.last_name FROM Students AS T1 JOIN Student_Enrolment AS T2 ON T1.student_id  =  T2.student_id JOIN Degree_Programs AS T3 ON T2.degree_program_id  =  T3.degree_program_id WHERE T3.degree_summary_name  =  'Bachelor'

cases.question: Which department offers the most number of degrees? List department name and id.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT T2.department_name ,  T1.department_id FROM Degree_Programs AS T1 JOIN Departments AS T2 ON T1.department_id  =  T2.department_id GROUP BY T1.department_id ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: Which owner has paid for the most treatments on his or her dogs? List the owner id and last name.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT T1.owner_id ,  T1.last_name FROM Owners AS T1 JOIN Dogs AS T2 ON T1.owner_id  =  T2.owner_id JOIN Treatments AS T3 ON T2.dog_id  =  T3.dog_id GROUP BY T1.owner_id ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: Which owner owns the most dogs? List the owner id, first name and last name.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT T1.owner_id ,  T2.first_name ,  T2.last_name FROM Dogs AS T1 JOIN Owners AS T2 ON T1.owner_id  =  T2.owner_id GROUP BY T1.owner_id ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: Find the name of the makers that produced some cars in the year of 1970?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.Maker FROM CAR_MAKERS AS T1 JOIN MODEL_LIST AS T2 ON T1.Id  =  T2.Maker JOIN CAR_NAMES AS T3 ON T2.model  =  T3.model JOIN CARS_DATA AS T4 ON T3.MakeId  =  T4.id WHERE T4.year  =  '1970';

cases.question: How many countries does each continent have? List the continent id, continent name and the number of countries.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT T1.ContId ,  T1.Continent ,  count(*) FROM CONTINENTS AS T1 JOIN COUNTRIES AS T2 ON T1.ContId  =  T2.Continent GROUP BY T1.ContId;

cases.question: List all singer names in concerts in year 2014.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT T2.name FROM singer_in_concert AS T1 JOIN singer AS T2 ON T1.singer_id  =  T2.singer_id JOIN concert AS T3 ON T1.concert_id  =  T3.concert_id WHERE T3.year  =  2014
